anu: quick note while onboarding nebula-16b-int4: longprefill run produced 'entangled lanes' (odd-lane scramble) after ~52k tokens, unique pattern vs previous models

rob: entangled lanes? can you paste tiny repro and logs

anu: repro command below, tiny log excerpt after failure
```
./run_longprefill --model nebula-16b-int4 --file long/headers_repeat.txt --max-tokens 80000 --seed 11 --kv-check
[2026-06-15T11:03:02Z] kv: shard=2 write_idx=52486 expected_rot=52487 actual_rot=52484
[2026-06-15T11:03:02Z] roast: odd_lane_scramble detected lanes=[1,3,5] pattern=010101
```

qabot: added a regression alert and uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/nebula16b/int4/entangle/1777700000.tar.gz

sophie: hypothesis: pack-interleave changed for int4 packing causing misalign on every-other lane when phase arithmetic assumes contiguous lanes. try PACK_ORDER=v1 fallback and ROPE_SCALE=0.5 to A/B

anu: tried PACK_ORDER=v1 -> reduces odd-lane occurrences but still sporadic at >70k tokens. setting ROPE_SCALE helped stability but hurt ppl numbers. saving seeds and will run a kernel bisect next. will follow up with small harness and seeds in the artifact bundle.
